name: Violet Undergrowth
description: Dark, damp undergrowth of the Violet Strata, green on top and violet at the roots.
role: The base ground of the Violet Strata.

artBrief.spriteScale: Seamless square tile. Floor entities tile it over a 4×4 cell footprint.
artBrief.silhouette: Flat tile of dark, tight growth.
artBrief.detail: Near-black greens with faint lighter blades; no bright accents.
artBrief.readability: Dark ground makes violet sap and machinery lights read clearly.
